title: Provenance
description: Timestamps and origin tracking for the metadata document.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dataset was first created/published.

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this metadata was ingested into the system.

latest_snapshot.description: Latest version/snapshot identifier of the dataset (e.g., '2.0.2').

uploader.description: Name of the person who uploaded the dataset.
